MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ornamental Fish culture? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Fish culture.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ornamental Fish culture.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ornamental Fish culture.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Ornamental Fish culture.

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Reproduction? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Reproduction.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Reproduction.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Reproduction.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Reproduction.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Record keeping in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Record keeping in aquaculture.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Record keeping in aquaculture.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Record keeping in aquaculture.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Record keeping in aquaculture.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.

10. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish feeds and feeding? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish feeds and feeding.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish feeds and feeding.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish feeds and feeding.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish feeds and feeding.

12. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Record keeping in aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. A — Glucose and oxygen

5. D — Ice melting to water

6. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.

7. A — 100 °C

8. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Record keeping in aquaculture.

10. B — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
